description: Climate Change Adaptation Tools for Transportation is a web tool or resource listed in U.S. Climate Resilience Toolkit, a national climate-adaptation toolkit, published or maintained by DOT Federal Highway Administration. The Federal Highway Administration (FHWA's) offers several resources for assessing the impacts of climate change and extreme weather on transportation infrastructure. Each tool offers links to an informational webinar to help new users apply the tool in their area of responsiblity. Coverage: the United States, or as stated on the tool page. The toolkit lists hazards: Extreme Heat, Flooding – General, Water Quality. Assets: Transportation and Mobility. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the toolkit page (no licence or terms statement seen). Caveats: this record was written from the toolkit page, which was read; the tool itself was not opened or run, its licence and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support climate-adaptation planning and exposure screening. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-us-climate-resilience-toolkit-catalogue.
